newsitem.title: USA: U.S. to suspend operations at Freetown embassy.
newsitem.headline: U.S. to suspend operations at Freetown embassy.

text.p: The United States has decided to suspend operations at its embassy in Sierra Leone where an evacuation of foreigners is under way following last Sunday's military coup, the State Department said on Friday.
"We have decided that we are suspending the operation of our embassy in Freetown," spokeswoman Julie Reside said. She could not say whether all embassy staff had evacuated the premises.
The State Department had said Thursday it was keeping on 15 staff at the embassy while evacuating 17 non-essential personnel and dependents.

The Defence Department said U.S. military helicopters backed by Marines on the ground had evauated nearly 500 Americans and other foreigners from Sierra Leone to the U.S. warship Kearsarge standing offshore.
